source: Quorum Design System handoff, attached to qwts/quorum#13

deltas.why: `hidden` is a global HTML attribute; a chip carrying it would not render at all. Rename only — the state is unchanged.
`id` is the host element's own HTML id. A screen reaching for its card by id would overwrite the record's citation number with a DOM handle, and print it on the record. Rename only.

note: Pinned to the 0.3.0 receipt, which the live components have since moved past (qwts/quorum#38): VoteChip's `ballot` union removed for `choice`, plus `pending`; PhaseStepper `failureKind`; ProposalCard `eligible`/`eligibleAt`/`roomMembers`; DecisionCard `reason`. Those are implemented here. `implements` stays 0.3.0 because there is no receipt for the live set to name — claiming a version that does not exist would be worse than naming the last one that does.
